description: This file is a PHP source file containing the definition of a class 'Category' which extends the OpenCart Controller class. It is part of the admin extension module for categories, handling functionalities such as displaying the category management page and saving category settings within the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Controller class for managing product categories in the admin extension, providing functionalities for displaying category settings and saving configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the category extension configuration page in the admin interface, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, loading dependencies, and passing data to the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of category module settings via AJAX, performing permission checks, updating settings, and returning a JSON response.
